message.warnTitle: Caution: this message may contain suspicious content
message.highTitle: Warning: this message shows signs of fraud
message.advice: Only pay through the platform; requests to pay by bank transfer, external link or messaging app are not covered by our protection.
message.blocked: Your message was not sent because it asks for off-platform payment or contact.

reasons.OFF_PLATFORM_CONTACT: Invitation to contact outside the platform

kyc.title: Identity verification
kyc.intro: Verify your identity to build trust with hosts and guests. Your document images are not stored on the platform; the provider performs the check.
kyc.redirecting: Redirecting you to the verification page…
kyc.requiredHost: Hosts must verify their identity before creating a listing.
kyc.requiredGuest: Guests must verify their identity before booking.
kyc.mockNotice: Demo mode: no real document is required. Pick a test document to choose the outcome.

errors.document_unreadable: We couldn't read the document photo. Retake it in good light, without glare, with the whole document visible.
errors.document_expired: Your document has expired. Try again with a valid identity document.
errors.document_fraudulent: The document could not be verified. Contact support before trying again.
errors.document_type_not_supported: This document type isn't supported. Use an ID card, passport or driving licence.
errors.document_unverified_other: The document could not be verified. Try again with a new photo where the whole document is clearly visible.
errors.consent_declined: You didn't give the consent needed for verification. Start again and accept the consent step.
errors.abandoned: Verification was not finished. Start again when you have your document with you.
errors.device_not_supported: Your device can't be used for verification. Try again on a phone or computer with a camera.
errors.country_not_supported: The country that issued your document isn't supported. Use another identity document or contact support.
errors.under_supported_age: The age requirement for verification wasn't met. If you think this is a mistake, contact support.
errors.unknown: Verification couldn't be completed. Try again; if the problem continues, contact support.

kyc.returnPending: You're back from the verification provider. Your result is being processed; this can take a few minutes.
kyc.pendingHelp: Your document is in review. This usually takes a few minutes; this section updates by itself when the result arrives.
kyc.pendingRestart: If you didn't finish verification on the provider's page, you can start it again below.
kyc.stillPending: Verification is still in review. Check again in a few minutes.
kyc.providerNotice: Verification happens on the page of our secure verification provider, Stripe; you'll come back to this page when it's done. You need a valid identity document and a device with a camera (a phone or a computer with a webcam).
kyc.dailyLimit: You can start verification up to {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} a day.
kyc.dailyLimitGeneric: Daily attempts are limited, so start when you have your document with you.
kyc.requiredHostDone: The identity verification required to create listings is complete.
kyc.requiredGuestDone: The identity verification required for booking is complete.
kyc.emailSent: Verification email sent. After clicking the link in the email, start verification here again.
kyc.emailAlreadyVerified: Your email address is verified; you can start identity verification again.

partyRisk.title: Party-risk warnings
partyRisk.intro: Automatic warnings computed from new account, single night, large group, near date and weekend signals. The booking is not cancelled; confirm the house rules with the guest.
partyRisk.empty: No party-risk warnings for your upcoming bookings.
partyRisk.caption: Bookings flagged for party risk
partyRisk.scale: Scores range from 0 to 100; only bookings above the warning threshold are listed.
partyRisk.scaleWithThreshold: Scores range from 0 to 100; bookings scoring {threshold} or higher are listed.
